Bathing is communal and single-sex, with women using the baths on Mondays and Thursdays and men on Wednesdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays; the operator publishes no co-ed days at all. Admission is a $32 day pass for unlimited access. No sauna or plunge temperature is published.

venues.name: Denver Sports Recovery

pricing.note: Day pass $35 for unlimited recovery-centre access — the walk-in product, sold as "basically a one-day membership". The private cold plunge and sauna room is $45 for 60 minutes; it is a private-room upgrade rather than a general single-visit rate, so it is not recorded as a drop-in. Memberships: Basic $120, Silver $165, Gold $240, Platinum $450 per month. The site publishes two contradictory punch-card price sets (a 5-visit at both $160 and $125, a 20-visit at both $560 and $399), so no pack price is recorded. Clinical services priced separately and not treated as recovery access.

venues.hours: Recovery centre Monday to Thursday 6:30 AM to 8 PM; Friday 6:30 AM to 6 PM; Saturday and Sunday 10 AM to 5 PM
venues.summary: Denver Sports Recovery is a recovery gym at 2242 W 29th Ave that pairs an outdoor 42°F cold plunge with a separate, deliberately warmer cold tub, dry and infrared saunas, compression boots, red-light and PEMF therapy, and clinical services alongside. Both communal and private access are sold: an all-access day pass is $35, a private cold plunge and sauna room is $45 for 60 minutes, and memberships start at $120 per month. Neither sauna temperature is published, which is the one gap in an otherwise unusually complete set of published details.

venues.name: Sway Wellness Spa · RiNo

pricing.note: Remedy Lounge unlimited membership $129 per month, month-to-month with no enrolment fee. Drop-in $49 per 75-minute session. Listed here under the current operator; the location traded as Upswell Studio until the handover.

venues.hours: Open daily, with session times shown at booking; the operator notes regular and extended hours are still being finalised
venues.summary: Sway Wellness Spa · RiNo took over the former Upswell Studio at 3636 Blake St and runs it as a shared recovery lounge with a large in-ground cold plunge, warm-water immersion, dry and infrared sauna cabins and compression therapy. A 75-minute shared session is $49 as a drop-in, or $129 per month for unlimited daily access. The operator states that regular and extended hours are still being set, so the schedule shown at booking is the only reliable one. No sauna or plunge temperature is published.

venues.name: Therma Haus

pricing.note: Single session $40. The $90 per month membership is an introductory Founding Member rate, limited to the first 100 members and to a member's first 6 months; the venue does not publish the standard rate that follows. Other memberships: $120 for eight sessions, $165 unlimited, $120 off-peak unlimited. Session packs: $150 for five, $270 for ten, $480 for twenty. No day pass is published. The homepage separately describes the plunges as "chilled to 35°F" while the services section names 36°F, 42°F and 50°F; the three stated setpoints are recorded here.

venues.hours: Monday to Sunday, 8 AM to 10 AM and 4 PM to 8 PM
venues.summary: Therma Haus is a Western Red Cedar sauna and cold-plunge studio at 2520 Wewatta Way, and one of the very few Denver venues that publishes every setpoint it runs: two Finnish saunas, one at 170°F for longer sessions and one at 190°F, and three cold plunges spanning 36°F to 50°F. Sessions are $40, and it now opens seven days a week in two blocks, morning and late afternoon. Its $90 membership is a founding-member introductory rate rather than a standing price.

venues.name: Red Rock Sauna

pricing.note: Drop-in $35. Three-pack $90, which the studio states as $30 per visit; six-pack $160 at $26.67 per visit. Both packs expire six months after purchase. Memberships: eight credits $125 per month, unlimited $149 per month.

venues.hours: Monday 7 AM to 11 AM and 4 PM to 9 PM; Tuesday to Thursday 4 PM to 9 PM; Friday 7 AM to 11 AM and 4 PM to 9 PM; Saturday and Sunday 7 AM to 8 PM
venues.summary: Red Rock Sauna runs out of Hogshead Brewery at 4460 W 29th Ave, pairing a cedar sauna it keeps between 170°F and 230°F with cold plunges held between 37°F and 60°F. Sessions are 50 minutes, drop-ins are $35, a three-pack is $90, and memberships run from $125 per month. Private group bookings are a buyout of the same shared room rather than a separate suite. The same operator also rents mobile sauna and plunge setups, so the brewery site is the fixed location rather than the whole business.

venues.name: Garden Sauna

pricing.note: Monthly unlimited $139. Single-session and multi-visit pack prices are NOT recorded: the visible pricing card and the same page's own meta description publish different figures ($33 drop-in with $145/$260 packs versus $25 with $111/$222), and two of the venue's own sources disagreeing means the field is withheld rather than adjudicated.

venues.hours: Sunday 9 AM to 9 PM; Monday 4 PM to 9 PM; Tuesday 7 AM to 1 PM and 3 PM to 9 PM; Wednesday and Thursday 4 PM to 9 PM; Friday 7 AM to 1 PM and 3 PM to 9 PM; Saturday 9 AM to 9 PM. The last session begins an hour before close.
venues.summary: Garden Sauna is a small dry sauna and cold plunge at 1407 N Ogden St in Capitol Hill, selling one-hour unlimited sessions in a shared space; private bookings are a buyout of that same space rather than a separate room. Unlimited monthly access is $139. It publishes a full seven-day schedule, including split morning and evening blocks midweek, and notes that the last session begins an hour before closing. Neither its sauna nor its plunge temperature is published.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Cherry Hills

pricing.note: Credit-based memberships: Level Up $190 per month for 8 credits, Elevate $290 for 14 credits, Core $330 for 31 credits. Retail per-service rate $45, or $30 for members, covering each of the four Core Therapies. Several other Denver-area Restore studios are reported closed; this one is listed as open on the company's own locator.

venues.hours: Monday to Thursday 10 AM to 7 PM; Friday 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday 10 AM to 4 PM; Sunday 11 AM to 4 PM
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness — Cherry Hills is a franchise recovery studio at 5046 E Hampden Ave in south-east Denver, offering infrared sauna, whole-body cryotherapy, red-light therapy and compression alongside clinical services. It publishes no cold plunge at this location, which is what separates it from most venues listed here — the cold side is delivered by cryotherapy instead of immersion. Access is sold through credit-based memberships from $190 per month, or $45 per service at the retail rate. It does not state whether its rooms are private or shared.

venues.name: ROK SPAS

pricing.note: No price is recorded. The only figure the venue publishes is "Plans at ROK SPAS start at $150/month" — a floor with no tier named and no unhedged rate anywhere on the site, and the registry has no way to render a price as a floor. Drop-in sessions and class passes are described as products but are nowhere priced.

venues.summary: A Nordic bathhouse by Union Station with a 194°F traditional sauna seating forty, five cold plunges spanning 37°F to 55°F, a steam room and thermal soaking tubs. It publishes both its sauna heat and its full plunge range, which almost nothing in Denver does.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio — Cherry Hills
venues.hours: Mon-Thu 7:00 AM-9:00 PM; Fri 7:00 AM-8:00 PM; Sat-Sun 8:00 AM-6:00 PM
venues.summary: Perspire Sauna Studio's Cherry Hills location is a private-suite infrared sauna studio in south Denver, with red light therapy and halotherapy built into each private room and towel service included. Sessions run up to 40 minutes; a single session is $50, an intro session is $20, and membership starts at $99/month for four sessions.

venues.name: PORTAL° Boulder
venues.hours: Sun 10 AM-10 PM; Mon-Fri 4 PM-10 PM; Sat 10 AM-10 PM
venues.summary: PORTAL Boulder is a wood-fired sauna and cold-plunge social club in the North Boulder Arts District, running two wood-burning saunas and two ice cold plunges around a shared clubhouse space. Access is sold as monthly, three-month or annual membership plans (from $99/month for four credits) or individual session credits, and towels are available on site. Neither its sauna temperature nor its plunge temperature is published on the page.

venues.name: Third Space & Co
venues.summary: Third Space & Co is a social bathhouse in Boulder built around four sauna rooms (ranging from private heat to social Finnish-style sessions) and three cold plunge tiers, plus a lounge and NA bar. A single drop-in visit is $30, a first-time 7-day intro pack is $7, and unlimited membership starts at $125 billed every four weeks; guests must be 18 or older.

venues.name: HOTWORX - Denver (LoHi)
venues.hours: 24/7 member access; staffed Mon-Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm
venues.summary: HOTWORX - Denver (LoHi) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.name: HOTWORX - Centennial

address.street: 9619 E. County Line Rd., Unit C

venues.hours: 24/7 member access; staffed Mon-Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm
venues.summary: HOTWORX - Centennial is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.name: The Sanctuary at The Skin Sanctum
venues.summary: The Sanctuary is a private-room infrared sauna and cold plunge suite inside The Skin Sanctum, an esthetics studio near Denver's RiNo Arts District. Every appointment reserves the entire room -- far infrared sauna and cold plunge -- exclusively for the guest, with sessions available in 30, 45, or 60-minute lengths. No session pricing is published as static page text; booking and rates are handled through the studio's online scheduler.

venues.name: Symmetry 360 Massage — Highlands
venues.summary: Symmetry 360 Massage's Highlands location offers a private infrared sauna suite alongside massage and cold plunge therapy in Denver's Highland neighborhood. The sauna starts around 100°F and rises to about 130°F over the course of a session, and a 20-minute sauna session is $25.

venues.name: iCRYO — Westminster
venues.summary: iCRYO Westminster is a franchise wellness studio offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, red light therapy, and compression therapy. An individual cryotherapy session is $25, and infrared sauna sessions run 30-60 minutes.

venues.name: The Cove Sauna and Cold Plunge
venues.summary: The Cove Sauna and Cold Plunge is a tiered-access sauna club in Denver's Baker/Overland area with multiple infrared sauna rooms, cold plunges, hot tubs, red light therapy, halotherapy, vibrational resonance therapy, and a gym. A one-hour Tier 1 pass is $24, and it's open daily except Tuesday. Membership starts at $69/month for four visits.

venues.name: Sway Wellness Spa · Larimer
venues.hours: Mon-Fri 10:00 AM-8:00 PM; Sat 9:00 AM-6:00 PM; Sun 11:00 AM-6:00 PM
venues.summary: Sway Wellness Spa's Larimer Square location is a modern wellness club in downtown Denver combining massage and facials with a Remedy Room recovery circuit -- sauna, cold plunge, compression therapy, and LED light therapy in one shared 40-minute session. A Remedy Room session is $49 drop-in, and club membership starts at $99/month. This is a distinct address from the already-published Sway RiNo location.

venues.name: Sway Wellness Spa · Central Park
venues.summary: Sway Wellness Spa's Central Park location, formerly Upswell Studio, is a recovery-led wellness club in Aurora serving the Central Park, Stapleton, and northwest Aurora communities. The shared Sway Remedy Lounge offers a 75-minute session combining traditional dry sauna, infrared sauna cabins, cold plunges, a warm soak, and compression therapy, at $49 drop-in or $129/month unlimited. This is a distinct address from the already-published Sway RiNo location.

venues.name: Traverse Fitness — South Broadway
venues.hours: Mon-Thu 5:00 AM-7:00 PM; Fri 5:00 AM-2:00 PM; Sat-Sun 7:00 AM-12:00 PM
venues.summary: Traverse Fitness's South Broadway club, the original Traverse location in Denver, runs coach-led Thermotherapy classes blending a custom-built sauna and cold plunges with breathwork as part of its member fitness programming. The sauna is heated to 190 degrees and the cold plunges range from 40 to 55 degrees.

venues.name: Simply Sauna

pricing.note: List price for the 45-minute infrared sauna session; on 2026-08-24 the booking page also showed a $36 'Summer Sale' rate beside it. The 45-minute infrared sauna + red light session is $65 ($52 on sale).

venues.summary: Simply Sauna is an infrared sauna studio in Lakewood offering standalone infrared sauna sessions and a combined infrared-sauna-plus-red-light-therapy option, with optional chromotherapy. A 45-minute single sauna session is $45.

venues.name: Bare Necessities Floating & Massage — Fire & Ice
venues.summary: Bare Necessities Floating & Massage's Fire & Ice room is a private infrared sauna and cold plunge suite in Arvada, alongside float therapy and massage. A combined 60-minute Fire & Ice (sauna and cold plunge) session is $40, and rescheduling requires at least 24 hours' notice.

venues.name: RESET Mind & Body — LoHi
venues.summary: RESET Mind & Body's LoHi studio is a franchise recovery center in Denver's LoHi neighborhood offering infrared sauna, cold water (plunge) therapy, warm water hydrotherapy, NormaTec compression therapy, and LED red light therapy. It is open daily with a midday closure on weekdays.

venues.name: Hooga House
venues.summary: Hooga House is a Finnish sauna and cold plunge club in Golden built around two communal saunas, each seating 14 to 15 people (one silent, one social), plus three cold plunges. It also runs wellness classes including yoga, Pilates, and in-sauna soundbaths. Cold plunges range from 40 to 50 degrees, and it's open daily.

venues.name: Life Time Centennial
venues.summary: Life Time Centennial is a Life Time athletic club in Centennial, CO. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Denver West
venues.summary: Life Time Denver West is a Life Time athletic club in Wheat Ridge, CO. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Parker-Aurora
venues.summary: Life Time Parker-Aurora is a Life Time athletic club in Parker, CO. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Westminster
venues.summary: Life Time Westminster is a Life Time athletic club in Westminster, CO. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: City Cave Float & Wellness Spa — Near Southside

pricing.note: Infrared sauna $49 single ($30 member); float therapy $89 ($59 member); massage $129 ($89 member, couples $249). "Add A Partner" is +$20 on sauna and float sessions (a second-person price for the same private room, not a guest fee). Single-visit wellness packages run $119 (sauna + float) to $399 (Complete Wellness couples) — combinations for one visit, not multi-session packs. Cave Club membership is advertised at 1 credit per month with no dollar amount published anywhere in the served HTML.

venues.summary: City Cave Near Southside is a float and infrared sauna spa at 465 S Main Street in Fort Worth's Near Southside, where every infrared sauna and float session is booked as a private room with its own shower. The location does not offer a cold plunge, and no operating temperature is published for this location's saunas or float pools.

venues.name: Fort Worth Float Company

pricing.note: Contrast pricing (all on the Floathelm store): single cold tub session $20, 30-minute sauna $25, 30-minute sauna + cold tub $35, one-hour sauna $35, one-hour sauna + cold tub $55 for one person / $90 for two, group sauna session $99. Packs: cold plunge 10-pack $149, sauna + cold plunge 5-pack $199. Sauna & cold plunge memberships $129/mo (once a week) and $149/mo (twice a week); the once-a-month $49 tier was dropped in August 2026. Float memberships from $49/mo. Floats $74 (60 min) / $94 (90 min), couples $125/$149. The $64 First Time Float is first-timers only, Mondays and Tuesdays. HaloTherapy salt booth session $39.

venues.summary: Fort Worth Float Company is a float-therapy studio on River Oaks Boulevard in northwest Fort Worth that also books an infrared sauna and cold plunge as a single private room, alongside three private float rooms and a halotherapy salt booth. All pricing is published on its Floathelm booking store rather than the main site, and the business publishes no operating temperatures for the sauna or plunge and no posted business hours.

venues.name: Infrared Mind + Body — Fort Worth

pricing.note: Each Wellness Credit (one 30-minute session) is $29; a 60-minute session is $10 extra. The introductory visit is free with promo code 'NCT' (usable at either of the operator's two clinics). Memberships: Benefit Flex $20/mo (no sessions included; discounts each credit to $15, limit one per day), Immunity Booster $69/mo (4 credits), The Unlimited $159 — labeled '/month' but billed on a 14-day auto-renewing cycle, limit one session per day. Packs: The Boost $109 for 5 credits, The Works $199 for 10; both expire 90 days after purchase. Membership cancellation requires written notice at least 15 days before the end of the current cycle. Family plan: second member 30% off, each additional 10% off.

venues.summary: Infrared Mind + Body is an infrared-sauna clinic at Alliance Town Center in north Fort Worth, where each session is taken in a private room with its own far-infrared cabin whose temperature is adjustable from 135–149°F, alongside LightStim LED facials. There is no cold plunge or other contrast modality at this location. Sessions are sold as Wellness Credits at a published single-session rate, with packs and memberships discounting the per-visit price.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio — FW Waterside

pricing.note: Single session $50; $20 intro session for new guests only. Memberships: IRelax $99/mo (4 sessions), IRecover $159/mo (8), IRitual $199/mo (unlimited). Session packs: 4 for $140, 8 for $240, 20 for $480 (the 20-pack is a one-time payment valid 12 months). Sessions run up to 40 minutes; no all-day admission is offered.

venues.summary: Perspire Sauna Studio — FW Waterside is a franchise infrared sauna studio in the Waterside development in southwest Fort Worth, where every session is booked into a private suite rather than a shared floor. Sessions run up to 40 minutes and pair full-spectrum infrared with medical-grade red light therapy, with halotherapy listed among the location’s amenities; there is no cold plunge tub, and no operating temperature is published for this location.

venues.name: Restore + Revive Wellness Center

pricing.note: Single sessions are priced per service: cold plunge $25, infrared sauna $39, Revive Room (red light/PEMF) $50, and an infrared sauna + cold plunge combo for $50. Packs lower the per-visit rate (plunge 4-pack $90, 8-pack $160; sauna 4-pack $140, 8-pack $250; Revive Room 4-pack $180, 8-pack $320). The cheapest membership, Revive at $149/mo, covers IV drips/boosters/shots only — no sauna or plunge; Balance at $289/mo is the cheapest tier with unlimited infrared sauna, and Elevate at $519/mo adds unlimited cold plunge. Memberships carry a 3-month minimum. No all-day admission is sold; "Day of Wellness" bundles ($148–$265) are fixed multi-service packages, not day passes.

venues.hours: Mon–Wed 9:00am–5:00pm, Thu 9:00am–7:00pm, Sun Closed. Fri–Sat not listed: the venue’s own pages disagree.
venues.summary: Restore + Revive is an appointment-based integrative wellness center on Byers Avenue in Fort Worth's west side, where cold plunge, infrared sauna and a red light/PEMF “Revive Room” sit alongside IV therapy, functional medicine and other clinical services. The cold plunge is run at a published 47–49°F; no sauna operating temperature is posted, and services are booked and priced individually rather than as a bathhouse day pass.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Colleyville

pricing.note: Retail (non-member) single sessions are $45 per Core Therapy — infrared sauna, cryotherapy, red light, compression — with a $30 member rate; Mild Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy is $116 retail / $83 member. Monthly membership tiers: Level Up $190 (8 credits), Elevate $290 (14), Core $330 (31). Level Up and Elevate credits may also be used for IV drips and expire 100 days from issuance; Core credits are Core Therapies only and expire monthly. Memberships require a 3-month commitment and 30 days’ notice to cancel. Sauna sessions are “45 minutes or less”; no day pass is sold.

venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Colleyville is a franchise wellness studio at 4709 Colleyville Blvd in Colleyville, northeast of Fort Worth, offering infrared sauna, whole-body cryotherapy, red light therapy and Normatec compression both on credit-based monthly memberships and at published retail single-session rates. There is no cold plunge at this location, and no operating temperatures are published.

venues.name: SWTHZ Camp Bowie
venues.summary: SWTHZ (SweatHouz) Camp Bowie is a franchise contrast-therapy studio at 6252 Camp Bowie Blvd in west Fort Worth, where each booking is a private 60-minute suite containing an infrared sauna, a cold plunge, and a vitamin C shower. Neither a price nor an operating temperature nor hours are published on any page attributable to this location, and its site blocks automated reading, so no facts beyond the brand’s suite model are recorded.

venues.name: Body Haxx Cryo

pricing.note: Red Light Pod Therapy: single 30-minute session $65, five-session pack $199, and a red-light-only unlimited membership at $219 per month.

venues.summary: Body Haxx Cryo is a cryotherapy and recovery studio at 603 W Harwood Rd in Hurst, in the Fort Worth Mid-Cities, open Monday-Friday 10am-7pm and Saturday 10am-5pm. A single Red Light Pod Therapy session is $65 (30 minutes); a 5-session pack is $199, and an unlimited monthly 'Red Light Therapy Only' membership is $219. The studio also offers whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna and compression therapy.

venues.name: iCRYO Fort Worth (West 7th)
venues.summary: iCRYO Fort Worth (West 7th) is a franchise cryotherapy and recovery studio at 628 Harrold Street, open Monday-Friday 8am-8pm and weekends 10am-4pm. Its red light therapy service is timed at 15 minutes. The studio also offers whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy and IV drip services; no pricing is published on the location's own page.

venues.name: Sound Waves Wellness

pricing.note: LED light therapy: single session $39, six-session pack $185, or a $179 per month unlimited membership capped at one session per day.

venues.summary: Sound Waves Wellness, at 4524 Boat Club Rd Ste 154 in Fort Worth, sells LED light therapy as a single $39 session, a six-session pack for $185, or a $179/month unlimited membership capped at one session per day. The studio also offers infrared sauna, halotherapy and vibroacoustic therapy at the same address.

venues.name: R&R Aesthetics & Wellness
venues.summary: R&R Aesthetics & Wellness is a medspa in south Fort Worth whose red and near-infrared light therapy sessions run 15-20 minutes. The practice's Holistic Wellness Lounge also lists cold plunge, infrared sauna, compression boots and PEMF among its recovery services, alongside a large menu of injectables, laser and body-contouring treatments. No per-session or membership pricing for these wellness therapies is published on the practice's site.

venues.name: Fort Worth Concierge Plus (Game On Wellness)
venues.summary: Fort Worth Concierge Plus, operating out of Game On Wellness at 2600 Alemeda St. in Fort Worth, is a concierge medicine and aesthetics practice that lists red light therapy among its aesthetics services and cryotherapy among its wellness services. The practice operates strictly by appointment. No pricing for red light therapy is published on the practice's site.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Southlake

pricing.note: Credit-based memberships: Level Up $190 per month for 8 Core Therapy credits, Elevate $290 for 14 credits, Core $330 for 31 credits. No non-member single-session price is published on the location page.

venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Southlake, a sibling franchise location to the Colleyville studio already tracked for this metro, is at 2600 E Southlake Blvd, open Monday-Friday 10am-7pm, Saturday 9am-5pm and Sunday 12pm-5pm. Its entry-level 'Level Up' membership is $190/month for 8 Core Therapy credits, redeemable for cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression, red light therapy or IV drip therapy; higher tiers (Elevate $290/mo for 14 credits, Core $330/mo for 31 credits) are also published. No non-member single-session price is shown on the location page.

venues.name: Life Time Colleyville
venues.summary: Life Time Colleyville is a Life Time athletic club in Colleyville, TX. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Mansfield
venues.summary: Life Time Mansfield is a Life Time athletic club in Mansfield, TX. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Westlake
venues.summary: Life Time Westlake is a Life Time athletic club in Westlake, TX. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna, eucalyptus steam room and infrared sauna; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Fire and Ice at Calisthenics Club Houston

pricing.note: A $25 introductory rate for a first-time visitor is the only rate published on the venue's own site; no standard drop-in, day pass or membership price appears there. Its GymMaster signup page prices the same "Intro Fire & Ice" at $25 but describes it as good for 30 days, so what the rate buys — one visit or a month — is stated differently by the two, and only the price itself is treated as settled here.

venues.summary: A cold plunge and traditional sauna run as a communal contrast circuit at a calisthenics gym on Montrose Boulevard. Its published class schedule marks a number of the sessions "Unstaffed", so some bookable slots are unsupervised.

pricing.note: Contrast therapy (sauna + plunge) $45 for 45 minutes; infrared sauna alone $40 for 45 minutes; cold plunge alone $25 for 10 minutes; red light $25 for 20 minutes. Memberships are referenced but no amounts are published.

venues.summary: A contrast therapy studio on the Sam Houston Parkway in Humble, northeast of Houston, where each booking is a private room with its own infrared sauna, cold plunge and shower. Session prices are published per modality but no temperatures are. Its opening hours are not listed here: the studio’s own page states two different weekday opening times, one in its hours widget and one in its structured data.

venues.name: Löyly Sauna Lounge

pricing.note: Pre-booked contrast therapy single session $45; walk-in $55. Daily Ritual membership $149/month; Weekly Access $49/week; 5-session package $149; a 7-day daily-access trial is $77.

venues.summary: A sauna lounge on West Clay Street in Houston’s Fourth Ward built around contrast therapy, pairing infrared saunas with a shared cold plunge it publishes at 41–49°F. Sessions are communal rather than private — there are no isolation rooms — and run 45 minutes.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio — The Heights

pricing.note: Single session $39. Membership tiers: IRelax (4 sessions) $79/month, IRecover (8 sessions) $139/month, IRitual (unlimited) $179/month. An intro session at up to 50% off is advertised without a stated price.

venues.summary: A private-suite infrared sauna studio on Shepherd Drive in the Heights, pairing each cabin with red light therapy and a cold SNØ Shower rather than a cold plunge tub. At $39 its single session is the cheapest of the three Perspire studios in the Houston metro area we track.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio — The Woodlands

pricing.note: Single session $60. Membership tiers: IRelax (4 sessions) $129/month, IRecover (8 sessions) $179/month, IRitual (unlimited) $219/month.

venues.summary: Perspire's Woodlands studio, north of Houston on Kuykendahl Road, books private infrared suites with red light therapy and a cold SNØ Shower. Its $60 single session is the highest of the brand's Texas locations we track — memberships bring it down substantially.

venues.name: Huemn — Vintage Park
venues.summary: A contrast therapy studio in Vintage Park, north Houston, pairing a sauna with a cold plunge. Huemn does not publish its water or sauna temperatures, its prices, or whether the suite is private or shared.

venues.name: Huemn — M-K-T Heights
venues.summary: Huemn’s Heights location on North Shepherd Drive, offering the same sauna and cold plunge contrast format as its Vintage Park studio. No temperatures, prices, or access details are published for this location specifically.

venues.name: ALBI Wellness
venues.summary: A wellness studio on West Alabama Street offering cold plunge alongside infrared sauna, red light and Flowpresso compression. Its page describes the plunge only in round approximate terms rather than as an operating setpoint, so no temperature is recorded here.

venues.name: Gangnam Spa

venues.summary: Anatomy at 1220 is the brand's flagship Miami Beach fitness club, with outdoor and indoor sauna and cold plunge circuits, a eucalyptus steam room, and a hybrid infrared/traditional sauna with Himalayan salt therapy alongside Normatec compression. The club is open Monday through Friday 5am-10pm and weekends 7am-7pm.

venues.name: Anatomy - Aventura
venues.summary: Anatomy Aventura, at The Abbey at Aventura, is a fitness club offering hot and cold plunge pools, a eucalyptus steam room, and an expansive Finnish sauna alongside Normatec compression. Non-members can buy a day pass for $100, and the club is open Monday through Friday 5am-10pm and weekends 7am-7pm.

venues.name: Anatomy - Midtown
venues.summary: Anatomy Midtown is a fitness club offering hot and cold plunges, an infrared sauna, a traditional sauna, and a eucalyptus steam room alongside Normatec compression. Non-members can buy a day pass for $100, and the club is open Monday through Friday 5am-10pm and weekends 8am-8pm.

venues.name: Anatomy - Doral
venues.summary: Anatomy Doral is a fitness club offering cold plunges and a hybrid infrared/traditional sauna with Himalayan salt therapy alongside Normatec compression. Non-members can buy a day pass for $50, and the club is open Monday through Friday 5am-10pm and weekends 8am-7pm.

venues.name: Russian & Turkish Baths
venues.summary: Russian & Turkish Baths is a traditional bathhouse in the Castle Beach Club on Miami Beach, built around a Russian Room banya, steam room, and cold plunge, open since 1994. A single-visit admission is priced at $65.

venues.name: Pause Studio - Fort Lauderdale
venues.summary: Pause Studio's Fort Lauderdale location offers a private contrast therapy suite combining infrared sauna and cold plunge, alongside float, cryotherapy, and compression services. Its lowest membership tier (Base) is $89/month for 6 credits, and sessions take place in a dedicated private suite rather than a shared space.

venues.name: The Space Fort Lauderdale
venues.summary: The Space Fort Lauderdale is a wellness studio built around 8 cold plunge tubs ranging from 37-55°F and 2 hot saunas set at 176°F and 198°F, alongside red light therapy and breathwork. A cold plunge and sauna only single visit is $40, and unlimited monthly membership is $195. The studio is open Monday through Friday 6am-7pm and weekends 8am-2pm.

venues.name: Vitality by Pam
venues.summary: Vitality by Pam is a biohacking wellness studio in Fort Lauderdale's Victoria Park area offering infrared sauna, halotherapy, cold plunge, and red light therapy alongside facials and body treatments. A 30-minute Halo Sauna + Dry Salt Therapy session is $39. It keeps shorter hours on Monday, Saturday, and Sunday than the rest of the week.

venues.name: ReFlow Cold Plunge and Sauna
venues.summary: ReFlow Cold Plunge and Sauna is a contrast-therapy studio in Oakland Park, just north of Fort Lauderdale. It is open Monday through Thursday 6am-1:30pm and 4pm-8pm, Friday 6am-1:30pm and 4pm-7pm, and Saturday 9am-12pm.

venues.name: Miami Ice Club - Brickell
venues.summary: Miami Ice Club runs guided outdoor ice-bath and breathwork classes at rooftop locations around Miami, including a Brickell session on the Neo Vertica rooftop pool deck. The lowest published membership is $115/month for one class per week, and the Brickell sessions run Wednesday mornings, Friday evenings, and Sunday late-mornings.

venues.name: Life Time Miami at The Falls
venues.summary: Life Time Miami at The Falls is a Life Time athletic club in Miami, FL. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: beem Light Sauna — Downtown Minneapolis

pricing.note: Memberships and packages only — no single-session drop-in rate is published for this studio. The cheapest monthly membership is $129 and a 10-session package is $389. A buy-one-get-one first-visit offer is advertised without a dollar figure. The brand publishes a 40-minute session length and a 16-and-over policy on its national FAQ, but neither appears on this location's page, so neither is recorded here.

venues.summary: beem Light Sauna Downtown Minneapolis is a franchise infrared light-therapy studio where every session is taken in a private suite rather than on a shared floor. It has no cold plunge, steam room or traditional sauna, sells access through memberships and packages rather than a published drop-in rate, and states no operating temperature for this location.

venues.name: Carpe Diem Studio — Como Ave

pricing.note: The $20 rate is a Fire & Ice session (private cold tub and infrared sauna room). A separate Community Sauna is also sold, but its single-session price is published as $10 on one page and $15 on another, so no figure is recorded for it; its 5-session pack is $50 on both pages and is the cheapest pack here. Membership is $60/month with a $40 add-on tier, and a buddy joins a Fire & Ice session for $5. A $30 intro week is advertised but could not be verified against a stable page anchor.

venues.hours: Service hours Mon–Sun 9:00am–8:00pm (the studio also publishes separate class hours from 6:00am)
venues.summary: Carpe Diem's Como Ave studio in St Paul runs a private Fire & Ice room — a single-occupant cold tub at 50°F paired with an infrared sauna at 140°F — alongside a two-person Community Sauna, which the studio states is held only at this location. Sessions are 20 minutes; the single-session Community Sauna price is published two different ways on the studio's own pages, so it is not listed here.

venues.name: Carpe Diem Studio — Northeast

pricing.note: A Fire & Ice session (private cold tub and infrared sauna room) is $20, with a 5-session pack at $100, a $60/month membership and a $5 buddy add-on. The Community Sauna is held only at the Como Ave studio, not here. A $30 intro week is advertised but could not be verified against a stable page anchor.

venues.summary: Carpe Diem's Northeast Minneapolis studio books a private Fire & Ice room — a single-occupant cold tub at 50°F paired with an infrared sauna at 140°F — in 20-minute sessions. Unlike the operator's Como Ave studio it has no Community Sauna, and it publishes no facility hours of its own: the only hours on its page are the studio's class schedule, which does not govern a sauna booking.

venues.name: Embrace North

pricing.note: A single session is $27.50 and the cheapest membership $49.95/month; both are published on the operator's site as covering all of its locations, this one included. New guests get two complimentary sessions. Bookings open seven days ahead, a late cancellation inside three hours forfeits the credit, and a no-show costs $8.

venues.summary: Embrace North is a communal bathhouse in Marcy-Holmes, just off the University of Minnesota campus, built around three electric saunas and one large cold spa that seats 9 to 13 people — you share the vessels with whoever else booked that hour rather than renting a private room. Access is sold as one-hour reserved sessions: $27.50 for a drop-in, or $49.95 a month for unlimited use that also covers the company's Denver location. It does publish setpoints, which is rarer than it should be: saunas at 200 F and the cold spa at 38-43 F — though those numbers sit on the shared homepage covering both Minneapolis and Denver, not on the Minneapolis location page itself. Weekday doors open at 5:30 a.m., and the whole facility shuts the second Tuesday of every month for deep cleaning. There is no phone number published anywhere on the site; booking and payment run entirely through their own app, and email is the only contact method listed.

venues.name: Forest Floor Wellness

pricing.note: A 75-minute private indoor session is $40 per person, with party pricing up to $140 for five. The studio also runs a separate Sauna Bath Ritual, aimed at 160°F, and a wood-fired community/mobile sauna running 160–210°F that is closed for the summer. A "summersauna25" code is a seasonal promotion, not a standing rate.

venues.hours: Sun closed; Mon 12:30pm–8:30pm (see venue for the rest of the week)
venues.summary: Forest Floor Wellness in Burnsville books its indoor hot room privately in 75-minute sessions, aiming to hold it at 180°F. There is no cold plunge at all — the studio directs guests to its patio, snow, or a bucket of lake water to cool down — and its other sauna products, a cooler bath ritual and a wood-fired mobile sauna, are separate offerings with their own temperatures.

venues.name: Minnesota Integrative Health Studio

pricing.note: A 60-minute infrared sauna session is $20, with $10 per additional person up to four. The cheapest membership is $170/month (four acupuncture visits, four sauna sessions and one private treatment, six-month minimum), with a $200 tier above it. A towel service fee is published as $5 on one page and $2 on another.

venues.summary: Minnesota Integrative Health Studio books its two infrared sauna rooms privately in 60-minute sessions at $20 a person, alongside acupuncture and clinical services. It has no cold plunge or traditional sauna, publishes no operating temperature, and states no sauna-specific opening hours — the only hours on its site are clinic hours in structured data, and those disagree between generators.

venues.name: NØRDHAVEN

pricing.note: A shared 90-minute session is $45; the whole sauna can be reserved for $275 for up to ten people, which is a buyout of the same structure rather than a separate private space. A $35 rate appears in the live booking system as a summer sale and is not the standing price. Cold immersion is the lake itself; an inflatable tub appears only at private events.

venues.summary: NØRDHAVEN is a mobile wood-fired sauna at White Bear Lake running shared 90-minute sessions at $45, with the whole sauna bookable for $275. Cold immersion is the lake itself rather than a chilled tub, and the temperature figures in its booking waiver are risk bounds rather than operating setpoints, so none is recorded.

venues.name: PORTAL° West Maka Ska

pricing.note: Membership-only pricing: the cheapest tier is $99/month for four credits. Credits are also sold singly at $32.50 and in packs ($162.50 for six, $325 for twelve), but the operator states credits are valid at any PORTAL location, and no per-credit figure could be tied to a quotable anchor on this location's page. Club-scoped unlimited tiers are published above the credit tiers.

venues.summary: PORTAL° West Maka Ska is the Minneapolis club of a small multi-city thermaculture chain (Denver, Bozeman, and an Austin location listed as opening soon), sitting on Excelsior Blvd just southwest of Bde Maka Ska. It is a communal social club rather than a private-suite studio: guests share electric and wood-fired saunas and a single communal cold plunge pool, with a locker room, changing spaces and showers alongside the social areas. Access is sold as credits rather than a conventional drop-in, with one credit booking one session ($32.50), 6- and 12-credit packs, and monthly, three-month and annual memberships in both limited-credit ($99/month for four credits) and unlimited tiers. What separates it from the metro's quieter bathhouses is a heavy programmed calendar at this location — weekly sauna socials, a Wednesday hip-hop temperature session, biweekly breathwork and yin yoga — so expect company rather than silence. Worth knowing before you book: PORTAL° publishes no sauna or plunge temperatures anywhere on its site, and its FAQ describes only the intended rhythm of three rounds of roughly 15 minutes hot and 3 minutes cold per session.

venues.name: Relaxing Healthy Center

pricing.note: Admission is $40 for the full day rather than a timed session. A discounted gift-certificate price is sold through the online store as a purchase-channel offer, not a standing admission rate.

venues.summary: Relaxing Healthy Center in Bloomington is a Chinese spa selling a $40 all-day admission, with a gender-separated clothing-free wet area of hot tubs and a steam room alongside shared saunas and lounges. It publishes no operating temperature for any room and does not list a cold plunge.

venues.name: Sauna Camp

pricing.note: A two-hour public session is $55. A four-pack, month pass and season pass are also sold, but the passes page renders every figure in a positioned gallery where document order does not match visual order, so each price was matched to its label by layout position and checked against the pack arithmetic; only the day pass is recorded here. Private booking reserves one sauna during normal hours; whole-camp buyouts run outside business hours.

venues.summary: Sauna Camp at Independence is a seasonal lakeside camp whose wood-fired saunas usually run 170–200°F, with cold immersion through a hand-carved hole in the frozen lake. Two-hour public sessions are $55 on a shared site; private booking reserves one of the saunas while the lake and grounds stay shared. The camp runs in winter and publishes no dates for the coming season.

venues.name: Sauna Strong

pricing.note: A 45-minute community dry sauna session is $20; community infrared is $24 and private infrared higher. The cheapest membership is $89/month with a $129 tier above it, and a five-session dry sauna pack is $90. Members bring two guests free each month. A free first-visit offer is advertised two incompatible ways — "first two sessions free" and a "free week trial" — so only the $0 price is recorded. A cold plunge is advertised as coming soon and is not yet operating.

venues.hours: Mon–Fri 5:30am–8:00pm, Sat 8:00am–6:00pm (Sunday hours are not reliably published)
venues.summary: Sauna Strong runs communal dry and infrared saunas alongside private infrared rooms and a single-occupant wellness pod, with sessions from $20 and memberships from $89 a month. Its infrared sauna gym is guest-adjustable rather than held at a fixed temperature, and the cold plunge it advertises is not yet operating, so no temperature is recorded.

venues.name: The PARC

pricing.note: A single Wellness Experience is $39.99 and a ten-pack $250. The first two hours are free for a new guest with no card required. Three membership tiers are named — Sprint, Sauna & Cold Plunge, and Group Fitness Unlimited — but none carries a published price.

venues.summary: The PARC is a Blaine fitness-and-recovery center that grew out of the Active Kids Association of Sport, pairing a full cardio and strength gym and group class studios with a shared recovery suite holding an infrared sauna, a traditional sauna and cold plunge tubs. What separates it from a gym with a locker-room sauna is that recovery is sold on its own: you reserve a session online through WellnessLiving with no membership, and first-time visitors get a free two-hour run of the place with no credit card required. A single Wellness Experience visit is $39.99 and a 10 Pack Recovery Pass is $250; the site also names three month-to-month memberships, including a Sauna & Cold Plunge tier, without ever printing their monthly prices. No sauna or plunge temperature is published anywhere on the site - not on the recovery page, the services page or the about page - so how cold the tubs actually run is unknown from their own material. Hours are unusually long for the category, opening at 5am on weekdays.

venues.name: The Rooftop at Hewing Hotel

pricing.note: The rooftop sauna and spa pool are hotel-guest amenities by default. Public day passes are $65 and sold only Thursday to Sunday, 11am–5pm, capped at six per day on a first-come basis and not sold on Sundays during rooftop concerts. Buyers must be 21 or over. The spa pool runs 100–102°F; no sauna temperature is published. The sauna cannot be rented privately.

venues.summary: The Rooftop at Hewing Hotel in the North Loop pairs a true dry Finnish sauna with a heated spa pool on a shared rooftop deck. Access is a hotel-guest amenity by default, with a limited number of $65 public day passes sold Thursday to Sunday afternoons to guests aged 21 and over. There is no cold plunge, and no sauna temperature is published.

venues.name: The Yard at Superior Sauna & Steam

pricing.note: A community steam session is $25 and a monthly pass $50. The $100 punch card is a buy-four-get-one bundle — its $125 compare-at price is the face value of five sessions, not a markdown. Session times could not be established: the schedule previously came from a booking platform that no longer serves us, and a currently-dated pass page gives a different set of days.

venues.summary: The Yard is a community sauna event run by a sauna manufacturer in Minneapolis, with sessions heated to 176–200°F on a shared site at $25 a visit or $50 a month. Its published schedule could not be established this pass: the booking platform it used no longer serves its pages and the venue's own current listing gives different days.

venues.name: Watershed Spa — Watershed Main

pricing.note: A bathhouse visit is $63 for a 2.5-hour reserved session rather than all-day admission. The cheapest membership is $155/month, but the venue asterisks it as an annual membership billed monthly — a twelve-month commitment — which is a materially different product from a cancel-anytime monthly rate. A second Watershed location is advertised as opening in late summer 2026 and is not yet operating.

venues.summary: Watershed Spa is a Nordic-style bathhouse in southeast Minneapolis selling a $63 co-ed bathing session booked as a 2.5-hour reservation rather than all-day admission, open daily until 11pm with last entry at 9pm. Its cheapest membership is billed monthly but committed annually. No operating temperature is published for the sauna, steam room, hot pool or plunge.

venues.name: beem Light Sauna — Savage
venues.summary: beem Light Sauna's Savage studio is a franchise infrared-and-red-light location, the same brand as the already-listed Downtown Minneapolis studio. Sessions are sold only as memberships or packages rather than a published single-visit rate: the cheapest membership is $129/month for 4 sessions, and the smallest one-time package is a 10-session pack for $389. The studio publishes hours for every day of the week but does not state an access type (private vs. shared) or an operating temperature on its own page.

venues.name: beem Light Sauna — Woodbury
venues.summary: beem Light Sauna's Woodbury studio is a franchise infrared-and-red-light location, sold only as memberships or packages rather than a published single-visit rate. The cheapest membership is $129/month for 4 sessions, and the smallest one-time package is a 10-session pack for $389. It is open every day of the week; access type and operating temperature are not published on its own page.

venues.name: beem Light Sauna — St. Louis Park
venues.summary: beem Light Sauna's St. Louis Park studio is a franchise infrared-and-red-light location, sold only as memberships or packages rather than a published single-visit rate. The cheapest membership is $129/month for 4 sessions, and the smallest one-time package is a 10-session pack for $389. It is the only MN beem location open at 9am on Mondays rather than 7 or 8am; access type and operating temperature are not published on its own page.

venues.name: beem Light Sauna — Excelsior
venues.summary: beem Light Sauna's Excelsior studio is a franchise infrared-and-red-light location, sold only as memberships or packages rather than a published single-visit rate. The cheapest membership is $129/month for 4 sessions, and the smallest one-time package is a 10-session pack for $389. Hours match the operator's Woodbury studio; access type and operating temperature are not published on its own page.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Blaine
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness's Blaine studio lists Red Light Therapy (branded Theralight 360) as one of four named 'Core Therapies' alongside cryotherapy, infrared sauna and compression, plus a separate menu of IV, hyperbaric and skin-health add-ons. Access to the core therapies is sold through monthly visit-credit memberships rather than a walk-in single-session rate; the cheapest tier is $170/month for 8 credits. No sauna/plunge temperature, session length, or access type (private vs. shared) is published on the location's own page.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Woodbury
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness's Woodbury studio lists Red Light Therapy as one of four named 'Core Therapies' alongside cryotherapy, infrared sauna and compression. Membership credits (shared across those four therapies plus IV Drips) start at $190/month; no walk-in single-session rate is published. The studio is open until 7pm on weekdays, later than Restore's Blaine location.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Apple Valley
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness's Apple Valley studio lists Red Light Therapy as one of four named 'Core Therapies' alongside cryotherapy, infrared sauna and compression; its own welcome text specifically names cryotherapy and red light therapy among its offerings. Membership credits start at $190/month; no walk-in single-session rate is published. Some third-party listings give this location as 'Saint Paul' with a different suite number — the venue's own page (Apple Valley, Ste 120) is treated as authoritative here.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness — Maple Grove
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness's Maple Grove studio, in the Shoppes at Arbor Lakes, lists Red Light Therapy as one of four named 'Core Therapies' alongside cryotherapy, infrared sauna and compression. Membership credits start at $190/month; no walk-in single-session rate is published. It has the most irregular published hours of the four MN Restore studios, closing an hour earlier on Fridays and opening later on Sundays.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio — Maple Grove
venues.summary: Perspire Sauna Studio's Maple Grove location (its own page's header reads "Maple Grove ... Minneapolis, MN 55369" though 55369 is Maple Grove) sells private infrared sauna suites with red light therapy and a post-session cold SNO shower bundled into every session. A single session is $40, the cheapest membership is $89/month for 4 sessions, and the smallest one-time pack is $130 for 4 sessions; guests may stay in the suite up to 40 minutes. The studio's own FAQ confirms suites are private.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio — Plymouth
venues.summary: Perspire Sauna Studio's Plymouth location sells private infrared sauna suites with red light therapy bundled into every session, matching the pricing at the operator's Maple Grove studio: $40 for a single session, $89/month for the cheapest membership (4 sessions), and $130 for the smallest one-time 4-session pack. Its own FAQ confirms suites are private.

venues.name: Awaken for Wellness — Saint Paul

pricing.note: Standalone 30-minute Optimization Room session $40, $99 per month for a 4-credit membership, $215 for a six-pack. Red light is also sold as a $10 add-on to a sauna session.

venues.hours: Mon unstaffed (massage/sauna still available), Tue-Fri 9AM-9PM, Sat-Sun 9AM-7PM; infrared sauna accessible 5AM-11PM daily
venues.summary: Awaken for Wellness's flagship Saint Paul location (operating since 2012) offers infrared sauna, float therapy, cold plunge, massage and red light therapy; its own per-location service-availability table confirms float therapy and massage are offered here but not at the operator's Woodbury studio. Red light is sold either as a $10 add-on to a sauna session or through a dedicated Optimization Room pairing PEMF, ONYX red light and a vibroacoustic sound bed; a standalone 30-minute Optimization Room session is $40, with a $99/month membership (4 credits) and a $215 six-pack. The location publishes unusual hours: unstaffed on Mondays (though massage and sauna remain available) with infrared sauna accessible 5am-11pm daily for all-access members.

venues.name: Awaken for Wellness — Woodbury

pricing.note: Standalone 30-minute Optimization Room session $40, $99 per month membership, $215 six-pack. Cold plunge and red light are also sold as $10 to $20 add-ons to a sauna session rather than only through the Optimization Room.

venues.hours: Mon 10AM-6PM, Tue-Fri 9AM-8PM, Sat 9AM-6PM, Sun 9AM-3PM; infrared sauna & salt therapy accessible 5AM-11PM daily
venues.summary: Awaken for Wellness's Woodbury location offers infrared sauna, salt therapy, cold plunge and red light therapy through the same Optimization Room format (PEMF + ONYX red light + sound bed) as the operator's Saint Paul flagship; a standalone 30-minute session is $40, with a $99/month membership and a $215 six-pack. The operator's own service-availability table confirms float therapy and massage are NOT offered at this location, unlike Saint Paul. Cold plunge and red light are also sold as $10-$20 add-ons to a sauna session rather than only through the Optimization Room.

venues.name: NE Wellness
venues.summary: NE Wellness is a Northeast Minneapolis studio combining Chinese medicine, acupuncture and massage with infrared sauna, float therapy and ONYX red light therapy; its own Minneapolis-specific services page confirms all three of those taxonomy modalities. Its red-light page states sessions run "a few minutes to half an hour" without a precise length. No price is published for red light therapy, infrared sauna or float on the venue's own pages, and no hours are published.

venues.name: Life Time Chanhassen
venues.summary: Life Time Chanhassen is a Life Time athletic club in Chanhassen, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Eagan
venues.summary: Life Time Eagan is a Life Time athletic club in Eagan, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Eden Prairie Athletic
venues.summary: Life Time Eden Prairie Athletic is a Life Time athletic club in Eden Prairie, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.summary: Life Time Minnetonka is a Life Time athletic club in Minnetonka, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.summary: Life Time Plymouth is a Life Time athletic club in Plymouth, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.summary: Life Time Rosemount is a Life Time athletic club in Rosemount, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Edina at Southdale
venues.summary: Life Time Edina at Southdale is a Life Time athletic club in Edina, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna and cedarwood sauna; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Woodbury
venues.summary: Life Time Woodbury is a Life Time athletic club in Woodbury, MN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge and steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Framework — Wedgewood-Houston

pricing.note: Weekday drop-in $35, weekend $55. A first-timer offer of 5 sessions for $79 is published brand-wide.

venues.summary: Nashville’s largest sauna and cold plunge studio, in Wedgewood-Houston, running its traditional saunas at 194°F across indoor and outdoor settings. No cold tub count or water temperature is listed here: the studio’s own site states two different figures for each, so neither is published rather than picking one.

venues.name: Framework — East Nashville Backyard

pricing.note: A first-timer offer of 5 sessions for $79 is published brand-wide; no per-session rate is published for this location.

venues.summary: Framework’s outdoor East Nashville site, built around a social 190°F sauna seating twelve and four cold tubs running between 40°F and 60°F. Smaller and more informal than the Wedgewood-Houston flagship, and it publishes its temperatures just as openly.

venues.name: Contrast Club

pricing.note: Single session $35; 10-session package $290; memberships $100/month for four visits or $180/month unlimited.

venues.summary: A private cold plunge and traditional sauna studio in Green Hills, booked as a 60-minute visit for you or your group rather than shared with other guests. Prices are published in full; temperatures are not.

venues.name: Pure Sweat Studios — The Gulch
venues.summary: An infrared sauna studio in the Gulch pairing private Sunlighten cabin suites with a BlueCube cold plunge, sold as 45-minute sessions. No temperatures or prices are published on the location page.

venues.name: Urban Sweat — The Nations
venues.summary: Urban Sweat’s Nations studio, one of several it runs around Nashville, offering infrared sauna pods and cabins with red light therapy. The brand lists a cold plunge among its services but does not say which locations have one — it names locations for other services, so the silence here is recorded rather than assumed either way. No temperatures or prices are published.

No temperatures or prices are published.

venues.name: Lolu
venues.summary: Lolu is a communal wellness studio in East Nashville built around a 40-person traditional dry sauna and a 20-person salt water cold plunge pool, with a private suite for up to four available by appointment. Self-guided Free Flow sessions are booked as 75-minute time slots, and swimwear or activewear is required for sauna and cold plunge.

venues.name: sēk Sauna Studio
venues.summary: sēk Sauna Studio is a private-suite wellness studio in Franklin's Cool Springs area, offering infrared sauna pods and cabins, cold plunge, red light therapy, and pressotherapy compression, each in its own private room. Cold plunge water runs 39-50°F; a single cold plunge session is $30, and membership starts at $89/month for three mix-and-match sessions. Sessions run 30-45 minutes for most services; cancelling within 8 hours of an appointment still uses the session credit.

venues.name: Pure Sweat + Float Studio — Brentwood
venues.summary: Pure Sweat + Float Studio's Brentwood location offers private-suite infrared sauna, cold plunge, and float therapy, plus a combined Contrast Therapy session pairing sauna and plunge. Infrared sauna sessions run a 45-minute session in a private cabin suite using Sunlighten technology; float therapy is offered in 40- or 60-minute sessions. No session pricing is published as static page text -- the 'New Client Specials' price slider stores its figures inside a data-attribute that carries no readable text once tags are stripped.

venues.name: Pause Studio — Green Hills
venues.summary: Pause Studio's Green Hills location is a recovery studio offering guided Contrast Therapy (infrared sauna plus cold plunge) in a private suite, alongside separate infrared sauna, cryotherapy, float, LED light therapy, and compression therapy services. venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Music Row is a franchise recovery studio near Nashville's Music Row offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy alongside IV drip services. It is open daily with published hours, and its lowest membership tier is $190/month.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - Green Hills
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Green Hills is a franchise recovery studio offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy alongside IV drip services. It is open daily with published hours, and its lowest membership tier is $190/month.

venues.summary: iCRYO Belle Meade is a franchise cryotherapy studio in Nashville offering whole-body cryotherapy in single- or two-person chambers, alongside infrared sauna, red light therapy, and compression therapy. An individual cryotherapy session is $25, and the studio is open daily with published hours.

venues.summary: HOTWORX Nashville (Midtown) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.hours: 24/7 member access; staffed Mon-Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm
venues.summary: HOTWORX Nashville (West) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.summary: Zivel's Murfreesboro location offers cryotherapy, infrared sauna, red light therapy, dry float, and compression therapy, alongside cosmetic cryo services. It is open Monday through Saturday and Sunday with published hours; a single infrared sauna session is $35.

venues.name: Life Time Franklin
venues.summary: Life Time Franklin is a Life Time athletic club in Franklin, TN. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: AIRE Ancient Baths New York · Tribeca

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page. AIRE publishes its experiences and prices through a client-rendered booking application, so no figure on it can be quoted or mechanically rechecked. Its published bath temperatures could not be located on any page of its site either.

venues.summary: AIRE Ancient Baths New York · Tribeca is a candlelit Roman-style bathhouse at 88 Franklin St in Manhattan, occupying 16,000 square feet of a restored 1883 textile factory, with a shared co-ed thermal circuit of hot, warm and cold baths, an ice bath, a eucalyptus steam room and a skylit Tepidarium. Access is sold as timed, pre-booked experiences rather than open admission. Everything else it publishes — prices, hours and bath temperatures — is rendered by its booking application rather than served as text, so none of it can be quoted or rechecked here.

venues.name: AIRE Ancient Baths New York · Upper East Side

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page: AIRE renders its experiences and prices through a client-rendered booking application. A "$245 + TAX" special-price banner is a promotion, not a standing rate.

venues.summary: AIRE Ancient Baths New York · Upper East Side is a candlelit thermal bathhouse at 305 E 61st Street in Manhattan, where admission is sold as timed, pre-booked experiences on a shared co-ed bathing floor rather than as open entry. The venue publishes no sauna and no operating temperatures for this location, and its prices are rendered by a booking application rather than served as text, so none can be quoted or rechecked here.

venues.name: Akari Sauna (Greenpoint)

pricing.note: Membership-only: no drop-in, no trial visit and no walk-ins. Greenpoint tiers as published: Daytime $165/month (Mon–Fri 8am–4:30pm, 4pm last entry); Unlimited is waitlist-only with no published price. A Summer Pass sells 10 visit credits for $315, but every credit expires on a fixed date — 31 August — so it is not recorded as a standing pack; Akari publishes no other Greenpoint pack. Guests must arrive and leave with a member and pay $35 plus tax. No initiation or cancellation fees; billing is month-to-month with a 30-day cancellation notice.

venues.hours: Unlimited tier: Mon–Fri 8:00am–10:00pm, Sat–Sun 9:00am–8:00pm. Daytime tier: Mon–Fri 8:00am–4:30pm, last entry 4:00pm
venues.summary: Akari Sauna's Greenpoint location is a membership-only, Japanese-inspired neighbourhood sauna at 149 Franklin St in Brooklyn, with two communal dry saunas, cold plunges and cold showers, and changing rooms that are not separated by gender. Entry is limited to members and accompanied guests — there are no walk-ins, trials or day passes — visits are capped at two hours, and the studio publishes no sauna or cold-plunge temperature and no price for its waitlist-only Unlimited tier.

venues.name: Bathhouse Atlantic Ave

pricing.note: No day-pass price is recorded. The venue publishes only "Starts at $29" with "Prices vary based on the day and time you choose", and its booking host shows "From US$29.00" — a floor, not a rate, and the real day-and-time grid appears only inside the booking flow. A floor cannot be published as a price here: it would sit in a comparison column beside venues that charge a knowable fixed rate and read as one. The pass has no time limit and no re-entry. Its $145 5-Pack and $250 10-Pack are both a limited summer promotion ending 1 September, with credits expiring two months after purchase, so neither is recorded as a standing pack; the standing multi-visit product is a $225 quarterly 5-Pack. Memberships are brand-wide and valid at all locations: Starter $145/mo for 3 Day Pass credits, Standard $225/mo for 5. Other published room temperatures: hot pools 104°F, neutral 98°F, steam room 115°F. The Event Sauna and infrared sauna are stated inconsistently across the venue's own pages (175°F vs 185°F, and 160°F vs 170°F) and are therefore not recorded.

venues.summary: Bathhouse Atlantic Ave is a communal bathhouse at 540 Atlantic Avenue in Brooklyn, open daily 8am to 11:30pm, with three thermal pools (hot 104F, neutral 98F, and a 50F cold plunge), a basalt-stone Banya, an Event Sauna running Aufguss rituals, an infrared sauna, a steam room, and an on-site canteen. It publishes unusually specific per-room operating temperatures and admission starts at $29, cheaper than the company's Flatiron and Williamsburg sites, but the actual Day Pass price is set dynamically by day and time and is never shown on the website, so a visitor cannot know the real cost without opening the booking calendar.

venues.name: Bathhouse Flatiron

pricing.note: No day-pass price is recorded: the venue's own pages disagree. The Flatiron location page and the brand Day Pass page both say "Starts at $39", while the homepage location list and the Flatiron booking host both say $29. Conflicting sources mean unknown. The pass has no time limit and no re-entry. Packs are brand-wide and MONDAY TO FRIDAY only — 5 credits $225 per quarter, 10 credits $390 — a narrower right than the memberships, whose credits are valid any day. Memberships are brand-wide and valid at all locations: Starter $145/mo (3 credits), Standard $225/mo (5). Other published temperatures: hot pools 104°F, neutral and salt pools 98°F, steam room 115°F, infrared sauna up to 135°F. Treatments are separate: massage from $195, hammam scrub from $130.

venues.summary: Bathhouse Flatiron is a communal, co-ed bathhouse at 14 West 22nd Street in Manhattan's Flatiron District, open daily 8am to 11:30pm, built around six thermal pools — two hot at 104°F, two cold at 45°F and 50°F, and neutral and salt pools at 98°F — plus a banya at 185–195°F, a dry sauna with guided Aufguss sessions, an infrared sauna and a 115°F steam room. No day-pass price is listed here because the company's own pages currently disagree on it, quoting both $29 and $39 as the starting rate.

venues.name: Bathhouse Williamsburg

pricing.note: No day-pass price is recorded. The venue publishes only "Starts at $39. Prices vary based on the day & time you choose" — a floor, not a rate, and a floor would read as a fixed price in any comparison. No time limit, no re-entry. Packs are brand-wide and MONDAY TO FRIDAY only — 5 credits $225 per quarter, 10 credits $390 — which is a narrower right than the memberships, whose credits are valid any day. Memberships are brand-wide and valid at all locations: Starter $145/mo (3 credits), Standard $225/mo (5). Rooftop lounge chairs ($69) and daybeds ($148) are separate add-ons that include a day pass, not the pass itself. Other published temperatures: hot pools 104°F, neutral 98°F, tropical sauna up to 185°F, steam room 115°F. The Event Sauna, dry sauna and rooftop pool are stated inconsistently between the venue's own pages and are not recorded. This location has no infrared sauna, unlike the company's other two.

venues.summary: Bathhouse Williamsburg is a communal, co-ed bathhouse at 103 North 10th Street in Brooklyn, with eight thermal pools plus a banya, dry sauna, tropical sauna, an event sauna used for guided Aufguss rituals, a steam room, a rooftop pool, and massage and hammam scrub treatments. It publishes unusually specific operating temperatures for each room, including two cold plunges held at 45F and 50F, but it does not publish an actual day-pass rate card — only a "starts at $39" floor, with the real price for a given day and time visible only inside the booking flow.

venues.name: Body By Brooklyn

pricing.note: Wet Lounge admission is $65 Monday–Thursday and $75 Friday–Sunday, sold as an all-day pass and included with any treatment of 60 minutes or longer. Multi-visit options are packages rather than monthly memberships: $325 for 6 day passes, $899 unlimited half-year, $1,499 unlimited full year, $1,499 half-year couples, $2,298 full-year couples. The private VIP Suite is a separate add-on at $275–$285 for the first hour and $165–$175 per additional hour, and VIP passes are not accepted at weekends. The Russian sauna runs at an average 175–190°F, the Swedish sauna at an average of about 150°F, and the hot tub 104°F. Both sauna figures are published as averages rather than setpoints. No monthly membership is published.

venues.summary: Body By Brooklyn is a 10,000-square-foot day spa and European-style bathhouse at 275 Park Ave in Clinton Hill, Brooklyn, combining a communal Wet Lounge — Russian sauna averaging 175–190°F, a cooler Swedish sauna around 150°F, aroma steam room, 104°F hot tub and a shared 52°F cold plunge pool — with a full treatment menu and a bookable private VIP Suite. It is one of the few NYC bathhouses to publish real operating temperatures, though it sells no monthly membership and its opening hours are not currently stated in a form we can cite.

venues.name: Brooklyn Banya

pricing.note: Adult day pass $60. The venue caps weekend visits at five hours and states no limit on weekdays. A $40 Monday and Wednesday rate and a $25 venik are advertised in places we could not verify against the current site, so neither is recorded. No membership or online booking is published.

venues.summary: Brooklyn Banya is a Russian bathhouse at 602 Coney Island Avenue in Kensington, Brooklyn, with a dry sauna and wet sauna heated by river rock, an aroma steam room, cold plunge pools and a hot tub, on a shared walk-in floor priced by a $60 adult day pass. Weekend visits are capped at five hours. The site publishes no water temperatures, and its opening hours and single-sex session times could not be verified against the page it currently serves.

venues.name: Brooklyn Bathhouse

pricing.note: The Standard Day Pass is $50 for four hours of amenity use — despite the name, no all-day product is sold. A Weekend Day Pass exists but its own page describes it both as "Sat & Sun All Day" and as four hours, so no weekend rate is recorded. A Summer Recovery Pass sells 8 sessions for $280 over two months, and a $30 Monday Reset deal is a limited summer promotion rather than a standing rate. No membership is published.

venues.summary: Brooklyn Bathhouse is a co-ed communal bathhouse at 731 Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn, combining a hot pool, ambient pool and cold plunge with three saunas, a steam room, a cafe and bar, and an on-site theatre. Admission runs on time-limited passes rather than all-day entry, and the site publishes no operating temperatures for its saunas, steam room, or cold plunge.

venues.name: Elahni

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page: Elahni renders its booking and membership pricing client-side, so no figure on those pages can be quoted or mechanically rechecked. The only static figure published is a "From $65" floor for its 70-minute Signature session, which is a floor rather than a rate.

venues.summary: Elahni is a contrast-therapy studio in Manhattan pairing a sauna held at 180°F with a cold plunge at 39°F across a three-round session, bookable as a semi-private space or a private buyout. It publishes the most precise operating temperatures of any studio in the city, but renders its session and membership prices client-side, so none can be quoted or rechecked here.

venues.name: Forest Hills Spa

pricing.note: General admission is a flat $50 ($35 for children), with a 5-pack at $225. A separate $80 Swimming Day Pass buys six hours and is a distinct product from general admission. No monthly membership is published — longer terms are sold only as six-month and annual options.

venues.summary: Forest Hills Spa (formerly Queens Fitness & Spa) is a Russian bathhouse on the Forest Hills/Corona border in Queens at 5921 Calloway St, serving clients since 1996 and last renovated under new ownership in 2007. Its communal floor pairs a swimming pool and 12-person jacuzzi with a Russian "shvitz" sauna, a Finnish dry-heat cedar sauna, an aromatherapy steam room and a cold plunge, plus a poolside cafe; notably, the venue publishes no operating temperatures for any of its rooms, and the full amenity list appears only on its older qfspa.com site rather than the current fhspa.com.

venues.name: Great Jones Spa

pricing.note: Water Lounge admission is $60 on weekdays and $70 at weekends and holidays. Admission is also included with treatments, but the venue states the condition inconsistently — its Water Lounge page requires a service of "$125 or more" while its FAQ and policies pages say any service — so no threshold is recorded. Guests receiving a treatment get two hours of Water Lounge access. No membership, pack or guest rate is published.

venues.summary: Great Jones Spa is a communal Water Lounge and treatment spa on Great Jones Street in NoHo, with a three-storey waterfall, hot tub, cold plunge, river rock sauna, steam room and a chakra light shower, sold as a $60 weekday day pass or included with treatments. Despite maintaining dedicated pages for its cold plunge and its sauna, the spa publishes no operating temperature for either — a notable gap for a venue of its size.

venues.name: HeavenLee Float Spa

pricing.note: A 30-minute infrared sauna session is $30 and a 60-minute session $50. Floats are $80 for 60 minutes and $100 for 90; a three-float package is $199. No membership, day pass or guest rate is published.

venues.summary: HeavenLee Float Spa is a private-suite float and infrared sauna studio in Queens, where each float pod and sauna room is booked individually rather than shared. Sessions run by appointment only, and the studio has no cold plunge and publishes no sauna operating temperature.

venues.name: HOTWORX - Staten Island (Charleston)

pricing.note: Two membership tiers are published for this studio, $79 and $99 per month, both plus taxes and fees. No drop-in, day pass or class pack is sold. A guest may be scheduled free of charge during staffed hours.

venues.summary: HOTWORX Staten Island (Charleston) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna workout franchise studio in the Charleston neighbourhood, where members train inside semi-private infrared sauna pods shared by up to three people. Members have 24-hour access while staffed hours are shorter, though the studio publishes two different staffed-hours blocks so neither is listed. Sessions are 15-minute HIIT or longer isometric workouts rather than bathhouse visits: the studio has no cold plunge, no traditional sauna and no steam room, and publishes no operating temperature.

venues.name: Ice Cold Club

pricing.note: A single plunge is $20 and the published membership is $120 per month. Bookings only — no walk-ins. The plunge operates inside a partner fitness studio rather than a standalone facility.

venues.summary: Ice Cold Club is a cold-exposure studio operating an outdoor rooftop plunge tub on the 5th floor of the Dime Residences at 275 S 5th Street in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, offering self-guided 15-minute "Quick Dip" bookings alongside guided group "Just Chill" open-plunge sessions with Normatec compression boots. The site publishes a single, unusually specific tub setpoint of 48F year-round, but the facility is cold-only: there is no sauna, steam room, or any heat modality on site, and the venue also states there are no showers, only changing rooms and bathrooms.

venues.name: Kove Studio East Village

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page identifying this location.
