venues.summary: Kove Studio East Village is a contrast-therapy studio on East 7th Street offering sauna, cold plunge and red light sessions. Its website is a client-rendered application that serves more than one location from the same page, so beyond its address and opening hours nothing it publishes can be attributed to this studio specifically or rechecked.

venues.name: Live Hydration Spa Long Island City

pricing.note: The venue publishes a full price list, but only as a downloadable PDF menu that cannot be mechanically rechecked, so no figure is recorded as a sourced field. As published there: a 60-minute private sauna and cold plunge suite is $100 ($80 for members), a standalone 15-minute cold plunge $30 ($24), a ten-pack $500 ($400), and the cheapest monthly membership $165. Members bring one guest free.

venues.summary: Live Hydration Spa Long Island City books its sauna and cold plunge together as a private 60-minute suite rather than as shared-floor admission, alongside IV therapy and red light. It publishes a full price list, but only in a downloadable PDF, and states no operating temperature for either the sauna or the plunge.

venues.name: Lore Bathing Club

pricing.note: The club states its dry sauna "reaches heats of up to 190°" — a maximum rather than an operating setpoint, so no temperature field is recorded. No single-session rate is recorded either: the club prices one visit three different ways across its own pages ($65 peak, $35 off-peak, and $55 in its FAQ), all under an "Early access pricing" label. Membership is $250/month, currently sold out with a waitlist, also at early-access pricing. A three-session pack is $149 and credits expire 45 days after purchase. Guests are $35. No day pass is sold.

venues.summary: Lore Bathing Club is a communal bathhouse in New York whose dry sauna is advertised as reaching up to 190° alongside a large 16ft by 7ft cold pool, sold in 75-minute sessions with a $250 monthly membership that is currently waitlisted. Its single-session price is quoted three different ways across its own pages and its opening hours four different ways, so neither is listed here.

venues.name: New York Spa & Sauna

pricing.note: Admission is $40 ($25 for children under five), with ten entries for $350. Admission includes a towel and a colour-coded uniform. No memberships or day passes are published, and reservations are not taken by phone.

venues.hours: Open daily 8:00am–11:00pm, 365 days a year (second-floor saunas close 10:30pm; the men’s steam room closes 9:00pm)
venues.summary: New York Spa & Sauna is a Korean-style jjimjilbang in Flushing, Queens, open daily 8am to 11pm at $40 admission including a towel and uniform. Every space is shared: the lower bathing level is a nude, gender-separated floor and the second floor is a common area with four co-ed dry saunas and an ice room, so a visit is two different experiences depending on the floor. It publishes no operating temperature for any room.

venues.name: Othership Flatiron

pricing.note: A two-week intro is $135. Class and membership prices are rendered by a third-party booking widget and appear nowhere in the served page, so no standing session or membership rate is recorded. The brand publishes sauna temperatures, but its own Flatiron page attributes them to Toronto, so none is attributable to this location.

venues.summary: Othership Flatiron is a communal sauna and ice-bath studio on the Flatiron block running guided group "journeys" rather than open admission, with eight ice baths in its cold room including a custom four-person tub. Its class and membership prices load through a third-party booking widget and its published sauna temperatures belong to the brand's Toronto location, so neither is recorded here.

venues.name: Othership Williamsburg

pricing.note: A two-week intro and a three-class intro pack are both $135. Class and membership prices are rendered by a third-party booking widget and appear nowhere in the served page, so no standing session or membership rate is recorded. The brand's published sauna temperatures and ice-bath counts are attributed to its Toronto location on this very page, so none is attributable here. A $45 fee applies to a late cancellation on an intro membership.

venues.summary: Othership Williamsburg is a communal sauna and ice-bath studio in Brooklyn running guided group "journeys" rather than open admission, with gender-neutral changing facilities and an 18-and-over policy. Its class and membership prices load through a third-party booking widget, and the sauna details and temperatures on its page are attributed to the brand's Toronto location, so neither is recorded here.

venues.name: Recovery Mode

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page: the studio's rates live inside its third-party booking script rather than in page text. Two corrections worth recording for a future pass — the $35 previously carried here is the sauna-only rate rather than a general drop-in, and the $30 is a Monday-to-Thursday promotion rather than a standing day pass. The studio also states three different cold-plunge ranges for the same tub depending on which product page you read, so no temperature is recorded.

venues.summary: Recovery Mode is a private-suite recovery studio in Queens pairing a cold plunge with an infrared sauna, booked as individual sessions rather than shared-floor admission. Its prices and temperatures are served by a third-party booking script rather than as page text, and the studio quotes three different cold-plunge ranges for the same tub across its own product pages, so neither is recorded here.

venues.name: Remedy Place Flatiron

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page: none of the club's published pages carries a dollar figure, and its booking application does not serve prices as text. Membership terms are also stated inconsistently — one page says a three-month commitment, another an annual one.

venues.summary: Remedy Place Flatiron is a social wellness club on West 21st Street where the ice bath is delivered as a guided breathwork class and the contrast suite is booked privately. It publishes no prices anywhere on its site and no operating temperature for its ice baths or saunas.

venues.name: Remedy Place SoHo

pricing.note: No price could be traced to a capturable page: the club's membership page is now an enquiry form carrying no figures, and its booking application does not serve prices as text.

venues.summary: Remedy Place SoHo is a social wellness club on Greene Street pairing private sauna and contrast suites with guided group ice-bath classes. No membership is required to book, but the club publishes no prices and no operating temperatures on any of its pages.

venues.name: Russian & Turkish Baths

pricing.note: Admission is $60, with five admissions for $250 (valid for one person). A robe, slippers and towels are included at no extra charge. Massages are $65 for 30 minutes, $90 for 45 and $110 for 60. Walk-in only — no reservations are accepted for baths admission.

venues.hours: Open 365 days a year, noon–10:00pm (opening times vary by day; see the co-ed schedule)
venues.summary: The Russian & Turkish Baths on East 10th Street is one of the oldest continuously operating bathhouses in the United States, with a Russian room, Turkish steam, sauna, redwood room and an ice-cold plunge pool on a shared walk-in floor at $60 admission, robe and towels included. It runs co-ed most of the week with two single-sex windows, and publishes no room temperatures.

venues.name: Spa Castle New York

pricing.note: Adult admission is $85 Monday to Thursday and $110 Friday through Sunday and on public holidays — note that Friday is charged at the higher rate; minors are $55 and $65, and infants are free. Admission is unlimited-stay with no re-entry. Memberships are $350 and $1,000 per month, requiring one month upfront to activate; members receive 50% off a guest's admission rather than a flat guest rate. No operating temperature is published for any sauna, bath or pool.

venues.summary: Spa Castle New York is a large Korean-style jjimjilbang and water resort at 131-10 11th Ave in College Point, Queens, where a single all-day admission covers a communal "Sauna Valley" of seven-plus themed hot rooms (including Himalayan salt, halotherapy, far-infrared and jade), an "Ice Land" cold room, indoor and outdoor hydrotherapy pools, and a nudity-required bathhouse with four heated baths, wet and dry sauna rooms, and one cold bath pool. Notably, the venue publishes no operating temperatures for any of its saunas, the cold room, or the cold bath — the site only says pool temperatures are adjusted seasonally — so anyone chasing a specific plunge or sauna setpoint will have to call ahead.

venues.name: The Keylin Experience Spa

pricing.note: A 60-minute "Sauna Exercise Membership" session is $210. Other services include the infrared sauna only as a component: a Clean Slate Wrap is $99 for 60 minutes and Keylin Make It Hot is $175 for 90. Separate facial-only membership tiers ($99/$189/$329 per month) carry no thermal access.

venues.summary: The Keylin Experience Spa in the Bronx is a treatment-led spa whose infrared sauna is sold as a booked 60-minute session or as a component of body treatments, rather than as bathhouse admission. It has no cold plunge, no steam room and no communal thermal floor, and publishes no operating temperature.

venues.name: The Rockaway Hotel + Spa

pricing.note: No admission price could be traced to a capturable page. Hotel guests pay a mandatory $55 nightly amenity fee that bundles sauna access; a seasonal day pass is advertised through a third-party reservation platform whose page could not be captured or rechecked.

venues.summary: The Rockaway Hotel Spa in Far Rockaway pairs private treatment rooms with a shared cedar sauna beside an outdoor heated pool, used by hotel guests, spa clients and seasonal day-pass visitors alike. There is no cold plunge and no steam room, and the venue publishes no operating temperature for the sauna.

venues.name: Wall Street Bath & Spa 88

pricing.note: Admission is $59.75 Monday–Friday and $64.75 at weekends and holidays, both before tax. Ten-day and twenty-day admission cards are $500 and $900. Towels, slippers and lockers are included, and there is no re-entry on a single visit. A Russian banya platza ritual is $60 for 15 minutes. The private VIP room is $350 for three hours, or $450 with a private sauna for up to six people. The jacuzzi runs 102–104°F; no sauna or steam-room temperature is published.

venues.summary: Wall Street Bath & Spa 88 is a Financial District bathhouse at 88 Fulton Street with a stone-heated sauna, an Old American shvitz, an infrared sauna, a eucalyptus steam room, a 52°F cold plunge and a hot jacuzzi, on a continuously co-ed floor at $59.75 weekday admission with towels, slippers and lockers included. It publishes no single-sex schedule, though it does not state one way or the other.

venues.name: World Spa

pricing.note: Admission is $99 and buys unlimited all-day access rather than a timed session; weekend and holiday rates differ. Memberships are sold as 3-, 6- and 12-month terms ($1,700, $3,000 and $5,000) rather than monthly, so no monthly rate is recorded. The venue publishes per-room temperatures for its saunas and banyas on its site, but only inside interactive elements that cannot be captured or mechanically rechecked, so only the cold plunge range is recorded here.

venues.hours: Sun–Thu 10:00am–10:00pm, Fri–Sat 10:00am–midnight (last call 30 minutes before close)
venues.summary: World Spa is a 50,000-square-foot bathhouse in Midwood, Brooklyn, with a cold plunge held at 48–55°F alongside multiple banyas, an aroma sauna, a clay-and-hay room, an event sauna and an infrared sauna, sold as $99 unlimited all-day admission. It publishes a temperature for every heat room on its site, but only inside interactive panels that cannot be cited or rechecked, so only the plunge range appears here.

venues.name: Life Time Sky (Manhattan)
venues.summary: Life Time Sky (Manhattan) is a Life Time athletic club in New York, NY. Its published amenities list a cold plunge; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Syosset
venues.summary: Life Time Syosset is a Life Time athletic club in Syosset, NY. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Equinox Domino
venues.summary: Equinox Domino is an Equinox fitness club in Brooklyn, NY. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room and sauna; use is by club membership.

venues.summary: Calor Sauna Studios is a women-owned recovery studio in Carlsbad Village with three private infrared sauna rooms and one specialized room combining an infrared sauna with a cold plunge. pricing.note: Prices are from Arctic Elevation's Washington regional menu, which covers its Bellevue and Lake Washington (Renton) studios: infrared sauna $50 per session ($30 first visit; 3-pack $100, 6-pack $200, 10-pack $275; unlimited $199/mo on a 3-month commitment), cryotherapy $60 ($30 first visit), red light therapy $85, compression $25. The $35 cold plunge session this listing carried in July 2026 is no longer published.

venues.summary: Arctic Elevation is a wellness treatment center in Renton at 1133 Lake Washington Blvd N #80, offering cryotherapy, infrared sauna, and cold plunge as standalone core services alongside red light therapy and compression. On its Washington menu an infrared sauna session is $50, or $30 for a first visit; no cold plunge price is currently published. Each modality is also sold as session packs and monthly unlimited plans.

venues.name: Banya (by FGM)
venues.summary: Banya is a European-style bathhouse in Everett at 2814 Colby Ave offering a sauna, steam room, 40°F cold plunge, massage, and red light therapy. Early Bird admission for reservations made online in advance starts at $35. The bathhouse is open Monday through Saturday, closed Sunday.

venues.name: Svette - Owen Beach
venues.summary: Svette is a Nordic seaside sauna and cold plunge operator on the Puget Sound, with this location at Owen Beach, 5605 Owen Beach Rd, Tacoma. Each pay-by-seat session runs 75 minutes, long enough for 2 to 4 rounds of hot-cold contrast therapy, priced at $35 at peak times. A monthly membership is $85. Credits and membership work identically at Svette's other location, Redondo Beach in Des Moines.

venues.name: Plunge + Restore
venues.summary: Plunge + Restore is a contrast-therapy wellness studio in Downtown Tacoma at 1101 Fawcett Avenue, Suite 111, offering cold plunge and infrared sauna alongside sound bath meditation and restorative yoga. The studio runs a split morning/evening schedule on Monday and Friday, midday-to-evening hours Wednesday, and is closed Thursdays. Sessions can be taken on their own or paired with the studio's yoga and meditation offerings.

venues.name: Fyre Sauna
venues.summary: Fyre Sauna is a Nordic-style, wood-fired sauna and cold plunge experience conveniently located in Woodinville wine country, at 14123 Redmond-Woodinville Rd NE. Both communal and private-buyout formats are offered.

venues.name: Svette - Redondo Beach
venues.summary: Svette is a Nordic seaside sauna and cold plunge operator on the Puget Sound, with this location at Redondo Beach, 28280 Redondo Beach Dr S, Des Moines. Each pay-by-seat session runs 75 minutes, long enough for 2 to 4 rounds of hot-cold contrast therapy, priced at $35 at peak times. A monthly membership is $85. Credits and membership work identically at Svette's other location, Owen Beach in Tacoma.

venues.name: Kodawari Studios
venues.summary: Kodawari Studios is a guided contrast-therapy studio in South Tampa combining an indoor Nordic sauna and outdoor cold plunge tubs in three-round sessions. The sauna runs 195-205°F and the plunge tubs 42-55°F, and membership starts at $159/month for four sessions. Sessions are 60 minutes, guided in small groups of up to 14.

venues.name: Chill N Out
venues.summary: Chill N Out is a full-spectrum infrared sauna and cryotherapy studio in Clearwater. A single infrared sauna session is $25, and its lowest monthly membership (Everyday Wellness) is $99. The studio is open Monday through Sunday with reduced weekend hours.

venues.name: DRIP Infrared Sauna & Cold Plunge Studio
venues.summary: DRIP is an infrared sauna and cold plunge studio just outside Brandon in Valrico, offering a la carte sessions including an Infrared Sauna Wrap Detox and a cold plunge ('DRIP Dip'), plus a combined Fire and Ice contrast session. A 5-pack of cold plunge visits is $60, and monthly memberships start at $75/mo. The studio is closed Mondays, open 10am-7pm Tuesday-Friday, and 8am-1pm on weekends.

venues.name: Embers + Ice
venues.summary: Embers + Ice is a guided contrast-therapy studio in downtown Tampa built around a Nordic-style sauna and cold plunge. Each guided sauna session includes three 12-minute rounds. The studio keeps split hours: Monday through Friday 6:30am to 1:00pm and 5:00pm to 8:00pm, with shorter morning and evening blocks on the weekend.

venues.name: Recovery Oasis
venues.hours: Mon & Thu 8am-7pm; Tue & Wed 8am-1:30pm & 2:30pm-7pm; Fri 8am-12pm & 1pm-6pm; Sat & Sun 9am-4pm
venues.summary: Recovery Oasis is a dedicated cold plunge, infrared sauna, and red light therapy studio in downtown St. Petersburg. A standing 20-minute cold plunge session is $35, with monthly memberships available on a 4x, 8x, 12x, or unlimited-visit basis. The studio also offers a Private Oasis suite and contrast therapy combining sauna and plunge. It is open Monday and Thursday 8am-7pm, Tuesday and Wednesday split hours, Friday 8am-6pm with a midday break, and 9am-4pm on weekends.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - Carrollwood
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Carrollwood is a franchise recovery studio offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy alongside IV drip services. Its lowest membership tier is $170/month, and the studio is open daily with published hours.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - Clearwater (Countryside)
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Clearwater (Countryside) is a franchise recovery studio offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy alongside IV drip services. Its lowest membership tier is $170/month, and the studio is open daily with published hours.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - St. Petersburg
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness St. Petersburg is a franchise recovery studio offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy alongside IV drip services. Its lowest membership tier is $170/month, and the studio is open daily with published hours.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - Westchase
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Westchase is a franchise recovery studio offering whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy alongside IV drip services. Its lowest membership tier is $170/month, and the studio is open daily with published hours.

venues.name: Perspire Sauna Studio - South Tampa
venues.summary: Perspire Sauna Studio South Tampa offers full-spectrum infrared sauna sessions with red light therapy in private suites.

venues.name: Plunsana
venues.summary: Plunsana is a dedicated contrast-therapy studio in St. Petersburg built around traditional saunas running 185-195°F and custom cold plunge tubs at 39-51°F. Memberships start at $90/month for four visits, and drop-in visits are also available. The studio is open daily with reduced weekend hours.

venues.name: Revivery
venues.summary: Revivery is a guided sauna and cold plunge studio in Oldsmar serving the northwest Tampa Bay area, including Westchase and Palm Harbor. A 1-Week Membership introductory offer for new customers is $65, and a 3-Pack of classes is $135. Class reservations can be cancelled free up to 4 hours before start; a late cancellation or no-show fee applies after that.

venues.name: The Sauna Guys
venues.summary: The Sauna Guys is a sauna and cold plunge studio in Tampa's Ybor City, open Monday through Friday from 5pm to 8pm. Its lowest membership tier is a 4-class Membership at $99/month, with higher-volume and unlimited tiers, plus drop-in and credit-pack options, also available.

venues.name: The Studio Sauna
venues.summary: The Studio Sauna's St. Petersburg location offers private infrared saunas, cold plunges, and red light therapy. A single monthly sauna session is $30, with tiered monthly packages up to a Total Unlimited plan combining sauna, cold plunge, and red light. Members can also add cold plunge or red light access separately.

venues.name: The Tampa Recovery Studio
venues.summary: The Tampa Recovery Studio is a health and wellness center built around contrast therapy, combining infrared sauna and cold plunge, booked in 30-minute timeslots. A monthly membership gives unlimited access to contrast therapy for $149/month, with access available six days a week.

venues.name: Sauna N Chill
venues.summary: Sauna N Chill bills itself as Tampa's premier contrast therapy studio, built around Finnish saunas and cold plunges. A day pass is $49, and an unlimited membership is $149/month.

venues.name: Body Aligned Recovery Room
venues.summary: The Recovery Room by Body Aligned is a dedicated cold plunge, infrared sauna, and red light space inside Body Aligned Pilates & Wellness in Tampa's Hyde Park area, sold and booked separately from the studio's Pilates classes. Sessions are private, with the room reserved for one party (or a friend) at a time.

venues.name: HOTWORX - Wesley Chapel (Wiregrass)
venues.hours: 24/7 member access; staffed Mon-Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm
venues.summary: HOTWORX Wesley Chapel (Wiregrass) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.name: HOTWORX - Tampa (South Tampa)
venues.hours: 24/7 member access; staffed Mon-Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm
venues.summary: HOTWORX Tampa (South Tampa) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.hours: 24/7 member access; staffed Mon-Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm
venues.summary: HOTWORX Tampa (Carrollwood) is a 24-hour infrared-sauna fitness studio offering virtually-instructed workouts (hot yoga, pilates, barre, cycle, and HIIT) performed inside infrared sauna pods. Members get round-the-clock access, with staffed hours on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

venues.name: Iceburg Cold Plunge
venues.hours: Mon-Fri: 7-10am, 11am-2pm, 4-8pm sessions; Sat: 8am-1pm, 2-5pm; Sun: 8am-1pm, 2-4pm (walk-in, no appointment needed)
venues.summary: Iceburg Cold Plunge is a dedicated cold plunge, infrared sauna and red light therapy studio in St. Petersburg, with tubs chilled to 36 or 42 degrees. No appointment is required -- visitors drop in during published open-session windows on weekday mornings, afternoons and evenings, with shorter Saturday and Sunday hours. Membership pricing is managed through an online plans portal not published as static text.

venues.name: Pause Studio - Midtown Tampa
venues.summary: Pause Studio's Midtown Tampa location offers a private contrast therapy suite combining infrared sauna and cold plunge, alongside separate cryotherapy and float services. Membership tiers are sold as monthly credits redeemable across services.

venues.name: Atlas Performance Center
venues.summary: Atlas Performance Center offers cold plunge therapy in Wesley Chapel. The cold plunge is open Monday through Thursday mornings and afternoons and Friday mornings, and closed weekends; the center separately offers a sauna.

venues.name: Game of Fitness - Recovery Oasis (Sauna + Cold Plunge)
venues.summary: Game of Fitness, a gym in St. Petersburg's Warehouse Arts District, runs a 'Recovery Oasis' sauna and cold plunge area included with select memberships, with punch-card and drop-in access for non-members. Sessions are typically 30 minutes in this outdoor, self-guided setup rather than a staffed private suite. This is a distinct business from the unrelated 'Recovery Oasis' studio in downtown St. Petersburg.

venues.name: Heim Regenerative Medicine Center
venues.hours: Mon-Thu 8:00am-5:00pm, Fri 8:00am-3:00pm, closed 12:00-1:30pm daily for lunch
venues.summary: Heim Regenerative Medicine Center runs instructor-led sauna and cold plunge contrast-therapy classes in Tampa, alternating rounds of sauna heat at approximately 190°F with cold plunge immersion at 40-50°F. The center is open Monday through Thursday 8am-5pm and Friday 8am-3pm, closed for lunch daily from 12-1:30pm.

venues.name: Life Time Harbour Island
venues.summary: Life Time Harbour Island is a Life Time athletic club in Tampa, FL. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, locker room sauna and cedarwood sauna; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Lakewood Ranch
venues.summary: Life Time Lakewood Ranch is a Life Time athletic club in Sarasota, FL. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna and cedarwood sauna; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Georgetown SunCryo
venues.summary: Georgetown SunCryo is a cryotherapy and infrared sauna recovery lounge at 1641 R St NW in Washington, DC's Northwest quadrant near Dupont Circle, despite branding tied to the Georgetown neighborhood. It offers whole-body cryotherapy and an infrared sauna room (fits up to 4 people), plus a separate Jadepod sauna, compression therapy, and red light therapy. A single 59-minute infrared sauna session runs $75, and the studio is open Monday-Saturday 10am-9pm and Sunday 10am-5pm.

venues.name: DistrictCryo (Mount Vernon - Shaw)
venues.summary: DistrictCryo is a cryotherapy and recovery lab at 1300 9th Street NW in Washington DC's Mount Vernon/Shaw neighborhood, one of two DistrictCryo studios in the metro. Its wellness offerings are whole-body cryotherapy and full-spectrum infrared sauna alongside PEMF and red light therapy, though the business has since added medical weight loss and aesthetics services. This DC location is open Tuesday-Thursday 10am-7pm, Friday 10am-5pm, and Saturday 10am-3pm, and closed Sunday and Monday. No per-session pricing is published on the studio's own pages.

venues.name: Ambitious Athletics Recovery Room
venues.summary: Ambitious Athletics's Recovery Room is a private-suite contrast therapy space inside a strength-and-conditioning training facility near Farragut/Dupont in Washington DC, bookable by members and non-members alike. Guests reserve 15, 30, 45, 60, or 75-minute sessions in a single private room featuring a cold plunge, hot tub, and full-spectrum infrared sauna. The cold plunge runs at approximately 51 degrees Fahrenheit, with the hot tub and sauna set warmer to complete a contrast routine.

venues.name: Pure Sweat Studios - Georgetown
venues.summary: Pure Sweat Studios' Georgetown location is a private-suite infrared sauna and float therapy studio at 3345 Prospect St NW in Washington DC, one location of a multi-city Pure Sweat chain. Each infrared sauna session runs 45 minutes in a private cabin suite built by Sunlighten with full-spectrum far, mid, and near wavelengths. The location's own page markets infrared sauna and float therapy only -- no cold plunge is described for this specific studio.

venues.name: Capital Cryo - Washington DC
venues.summary: Capital Cryo's Washington DC studio, in the Wesley Heights neighborhood at 3301 New Mexico Ave NW, offers whole-body cryotherapy and infrared sauna alongside red light therapy. The DC studio is closed Sunday and Monday, open Tuesday-Thursday 10am-6pm and Friday-Saturday 10am-4pm.

venues.name: DistrictCryo (Alexandria - Old Town)
venues.summary: DistrictCryo Alexandria is the Old Town Virginia location of this two-studio cryotherapy and recovery lab, offering whole-body cryotherapy and full-spectrum infrared sauna alongside PEMF and red light therapy. The studio is open Monday-Thursday 10am-7pm, Friday 10am-5pm, and Saturday 9am-3pm, closed Sunday. No per-session pricing is published on the studio's own pages.

venues.name: Awarehouse
venues.summary: Awarehouse is a communal bathhouse-style recovery studio at 2201 N. Pershing Dr. in Arlington, Virginia -- despite branding itself 'Awarehouse DC.' Its shared 18-person full-spectrum infrared sauna and two BlueCube cold plunges (one in the low 40s and one in the low 50s Fahrenheit) are used communally rather than in private suites, alongside guided breathwork, red light therapy, and a PEMF grounding mat.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - Arlington, VA (Pentagon City)
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness's Pentagon City studio in Arlington, Virginia offers whole-body cryotherapy and infrared sauna as its core in-studio modalities, alongside compression therapy, red light therapy, and separate IV drip and hyperbaric oxygen services common to the national Restore chain. Its entry-level 'Level Up' membership runs $200 per month for 8 monthly therapy credits redeemable at any Restore location nationwide, with 'Elevate' and 'Core' tiers priced higher for more credits. The studio is open Monday-Thursday 10am-7pm, Friday 10am-6pm, Saturday 9am-5pm, and Sunday 10am-4pm.

venues.name: Restore Hyper Wellness - Alexandria, VA
venues.summary: Restore Hyper Wellness Alexandria, Virginia offers whole-body cryotherapy and infrared sauna as its core in-studio modalities, alongside compression therapy, red light therapy, and separate IV drip and hyperbaric oxygen services common to the national Restore chain. Its entry-level 'Level Up' membership runs $200 per month for 8 monthly therapy credits redeemable at any Restore location nationwide, with 'Elevate' and 'Core' tiers priced higher for more credits. The studio is open Monday-Thursday 10am-7pm, Friday 10am-6pm, Saturday 9am-5pm, and Sunday 10am-4pm.

venues.name: KALM Studio
venues.summary: KALM Studio is a contrast therapy and movement studio at 800 N Henry St in Alexandria, Virginia's Braddock neighborhood, which opened August 15, 2026. Its recovery offering combines infrared sauna access -- described as private or shared suites -- with cold plunge access and red light therapy as an add-on, alongside separate Pilates and yoga movement classes.

venues.name: Balian Springs
venues.summary: Balian Springs is a large Korean-spa-style bathhouse at 6432 General Green Way in Alexandria, Virginia, featuring eight themed sauna rooms -- including Far Infrared, Himalayan Salt, Steam Box, and a cold 'Cryotherapy' room -- plus coed hydrotherapy and cold plunge pools. The club is open daily from 9:00am to 9:30pm.

venues.name: Hope Floats
venues.summary: Hope Floats is a contrast therapy, flotation, and infrared sauna spa at 7625 Wisconsin Avenue in Bethesda, Maryland. Its cold plunge runs at 45 degrees Fahrenheit, and a private 30-minute Contrast Therapy session -- alternating between a far-infrared sauna and the cold plunge in the same room -- runs $65. The spa also sells standalone infrared sauna and cold-plunge-only sessions by the visit, plus flotation therapy, fascial stretch therapy, and massage.

venues.name: Courted Recovery Suite Bethesda
venues.summary: Courted Recovery Suite is a recovery studio inside The St. James Performance Club at 6828 Wisconsin Avenue in Bethesda, Maryland, offering infrared sauna, a cold plunge pool, a cryotherapy chamber, compression therapy, and a PEMF mat. The suite is open Monday-Thursday 6:00am-8:00pm, Friday 6:00am-7:00pm, and weekends 9:00am-5:00pm. Per-session pricing for this Bethesda location is not published on the studio's own site; Courted's modality pages (cold plunge, contrast therapy) publish pricing tied only to its separate Springfield, Virginia location, so that pricing was not attributed here.

venues.name: Capital Cryo - Bethesda
venues.summary: Capital Cryo's Bethesda, Maryland studio at 4912 Hampden Lane offers whole-body cryotherapy and infrared sauna alongside red light therapy. The Bethesda studio is open seven days a week: 10am-4pm on Monday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and longer hours Tuesday through Thursday (until 9pm on Thursdays).

venues.name: Daje Wellness and Spa
venues.summary: Daje Wellness and Spa is a Moroccan hammam-style day spa at 938 Bonifant Street in Silver Spring, Maryland, offering a traditional dry sauna room and a steam room alongside Moroccan bath treatments and facials. A standalone 30-minute sauna or steam room session runs $25.

venues.name: Life Time Centreville
venues.summary: Life Time Centreville is a Life Time athletic club in Centreville, VA. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus sauna; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Clarendon
venues.summary: Life Time Clarendon is a Life Time athletic club in Arlington, VA. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.

venues.name: Life Time Reston
venues.summary: Life Time Reston is a Life Time athletic club in Reston, VA. Its published amenities list a cold plunge, steam room, locker room sauna, cedarwood sauna and eucalyptus steam room; use is by club membership.
